title: Won't stand up!
text:
Won't stand up!. Expensive piece of plastic that won't even stand up.
Don't waste your money on this.

product_metadata.title: Kurt Adler 24" Miniature Pine Christmas Tree
description: How can you add a touch of Christmas to any spot in your home? Place a 24" Miniature Christmas Pine Tree anywhere in your house for an instant reminder of the magic of the season. Place one on a bookshelf, in your child's room, on a windowsill, or put several of them together as a background with your other decorations. This tree stands 24" tall, has 275 tips, and stands on a round plastic base. This little tree is not only the perfect size to start a beautiful Christmas village on your side table, it's also the perfect tree because it is artificial and needs no watering or maintenance! These needles won't fall to the ground, and you can store this tree and use it again and again, year after year. It's a perfect replica of a life-sized tree, and brings a feeling of joy every time you see it.
